user_story: As a user, I want my password reset token to be invalidated after use so that it cannot be reused.

positive.title: Password reset token invalidation after successful password change
steps: Request a password reset token via email.
Receive and use the token to reset the password successfully.
Attempt to use the same token again.
positive.expected_result: Password reset token is invalidated and cannot be reused.

negative.title: Attempt to use an already used password reset token
steps: Request and use a password reset token to change the password.
Attempt to use the same token a second time.
negative.expected_result: System should reject the token, displaying a message that the token is invalid or already used.

edge.title: Attempt using a token immediately after using it
steps: Request a password reset token and use it to reset the password.
Immediately attempt to use the same token again.
edge.expected_result: Token is invalid for any subsequent use immediately after changing the password.
